To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the following are true: • The reactive model of computation is an excellent formal basis for the specification and animation (visualization) of complex systems.
we have developed a novel approach to reactive animation that allows us to animate complex object-oriented reactive specifications in a natural, reliable and efficient manner.
the proposed approach to reactive animation can be used for the development and maintenance of reactive applications and that the approach is applicable to a broad range of applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (1) the design of a general framework that allows the specification of complex reactive systems in a declarative and modular way, (2) the design of an animation framework that is capable of displaying such systems in an interactive, dynamic and natural way, (3) the design of the interface between the animation framework and the reactive system specification framework, and (4) the design of tools that implement the above.
the development of new techniques for the animation of reactive systems, and the development of a generic link between reactive specification and animation tools.
the design of a generic link between reactive specification and animation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Reactive Animation is an effective and powerful approach to the development of interactive applications.
the animation is an essential part of the design process.
reactive animation is a very powerful and useful tool, which should be applied to all reactive systems, and that its application is not restricted to the field of reactive systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed an animation tool that can be used to create and modify the animation of complex systems.
we have developed the first generic approach for the specification, animation and visualization of complex object-oriented, reactive systems.
we have developed a methodology for the specification and animation for reactive systems, which has been implemented in a prototype system, and we have applied this system to several case studies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can animate a complex reactive system by simply providing a set of rules to describe the animation.
it is feasible and useful to animate reactive systems, and that it is not too difficult to build a bridge between specification and animation.
the use of animation as an integral part of the software development cycle is not only possible but also beneficial.
